truth_operator: Cactus-compatible periodic Poisson and twice-centred finite differences; trilinear tensor interpolation at cell-centred coordinates; eigenvalues after interpolation
density_reference: Median recorded NTILDE_MPC3/h^3 in the existing DESI z=.20-.30 property wedge; a constant-density intervention, not full BGS selection
prediction_target: standardized ordered inverse-softplus eigenvalue increments; property-blind geometry inputs only
primary_outcome: quenched iff instantaneous total SubhaloSFR / total bound stellar mass < 1e-11 per year, including zero SFR
scope: Single-box mechanism experiment. Fixed held-out query galaxies and properties; rebuild periodic count/nearest-neighbour inputs for exact-size random tracer subsets. Identical regressor/budget and paired initialization per condition; no claim to reproduce GAT or P12-A, DESI selection, posterior coverage, or independent-phase validation. R2/R7 truth and full-density predictions cannot change with thinning.
